Title: Muhammara has a NULL pointer dereference in LZWDecode filter when DecodeParms omits EarlyChange key
Description: A NULL pointer dereference vulnerability exists in `PDFParser::CreateFilterForStream()` when processing a PDF stream with `/Filter /LZWDecode` and a `/DecodeParms` dictionary that does not contain the `EarlyChange` key. This causes an access violation (0xC0000005) and crashes the process.
